notes.title: Steam Next Fest update: Demo 1.7 and full game release date reveal!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! The Steam Next Fest has begun today, and there's a bunch of information regarding Slumberer's Universe I've got to share.


Full game release - Aug 20, 2025


First of all, Slumberer's Universe is releasing in about two months, on August 20! There's a new trailer released, announcing the release date:


[previewyoutube="IovVU54gjjE;full"][/previewyoutube]
The full game will feature chapters 1 to 4, plus the prologue. The story will be finally completed after all these years! Will Alph be able to overcome Walter's death? What is the memory he cannot remember? How is all this connected? Find out the truth and uncover the memories Alph wanted to erase in the later chapters! I am very excited for you to be able to play it, so please look forward to the release!!



The game still requires the final levels of polish – mainly some accessibility options, but the game has already entered content lock and the private playtesting has begun. I am so, so happy to have reached this point in the development.



Unfortunately, the game won't have any localization on launch. The Finnish translation from the demo has been removed too, since it takes too much time to maintain it. I hope I can get this game localized to some languages afterwards though, but no promises regarding that.




The demo - update 1.7 is now released!


This new version fixes some remaining bugs, adds graphical improvements and features some additional content in the story. This new update will feature the exact (or almost the) same versions of the first two chapters as in the upcoming full game, so you can see whether you like the game before buying it. You can also load your demo save in the full game and continue playing where you left off when the full game releases.



[spoiler]"I've got nothing to say here this time"        -Ralph[/spoiler]

notes.title: Update 1.6 - Slumberer's Universe demo!
notes.notes:
Slumberer's Universe demo has been updated!

What's new
This version basically includes everything that the full game will, for example:

save compatibility with the full game
autosaving
updated battle system
general QoL updates to the whole game
a few new features
minor story updates.

If you've been wanting to play the game for a while now,
Now is the best time to play Slumberer's Universe!
This version will ensure you'll get close to the same experience as you would with the full game in 2025.

Anyway, there's quite some new content available. Check the last progress update to see some of these! Now the only thing remaining is to get the last two chapters done (progress on the third chapter is going really well - it'll be finished in just a few weeks!)

notes.title: Version 1.5 released! New content + QoL changes
notes.notes:
The UX update 1.5 has been released!

Hi! This new update has a lot of improvements to the user experience. A lot of bugs and other clunky stuff has been fixed, and on top of that, many new features have been added!


Features:

These do not differ much from the initial announcement.

1. New content!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179817/cec0531e195e05b207901de63616f6d68fc559d4.png
Some new content, like the new beginning of the game, has been added! While it doesn't include chapter 2, there are some new secret areas for you to find in this update!

2. 16:9 support
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179817/2282729eb8537de433454bfc924fd6f58a6c3199.png
This is definitely the biggest change you'll see. I've ported the game from 4:3 to 16:9 to make it better on modern monitors. The game is only going to support 16:9 from now on, due to it being too hard to maintain 4:3 support too.

3. Improved UI
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179817/06b9fe04e5737e21d5db7e161f7dcced99e3ac1b.png
The UI is now consistent everywhere. The menus, title screen, battle system, text box and everything has been updated to follow the new UI guidelines! A lot of animations have been added too.

4. Improved battle system
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179817/acc30fa871f69f61a6bf6ccb951808c4ff3a9360.png
Some updates have been made to the battle system as well, featuring a combo system, new animations, and improvements to the dodge system. These changes will make the fighting experience much more fun! On top of that, the enemies have been balanced.

5. Other smaller (but not unimportant!) stuff
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179817/3239b78b4b677ffdc30905546132b8b8d3eabd6b.png
The graphics got a noticeable upgrade. They are much sharper than before! The soundtrack got a few updates, with one new, one remade and one improved song. On top of that, some optimizations have been made under the hood that will provide a faster and stabler, less buggy experience. There's been stuff done for easier and faster developing too.
There are a lot more minor improvements and/or fixes, but those aren't worth mentioning.



Q&A

Are the saves compatible with the new version?
Unfortunately no. The game has got so many changes that some things will be broken beyond playable in the upcoming update. You can keep playing with your old saves on the old version, or you can start from the beginning.

I don't like the new stuff. Can I revert to the old version?
Sure! You can download the old version either by entering the beta 1.0.1 from Steam or downloading the old version from Itch or Gamejolt to keep using this version.

Is chapter 2 be released?
Nope. Chapter 2 will be released with rest of the chapters in the future. The release date is still TBD and will take a few years at least.

Is Ralph featured in this update?
Yes? No? Maybe????



That's all for now.

notes.title: Slumberer's Universe Demo update - Now available on MacOS and Linux!
notes.notes:
Hello!

A new update to Slumberer's Universe demo has been released alongside the MacOS and Linux builds.

Changelog:

 - Made the chapter 1 forest puzzle easier and better.
 - Made the navigation in certain parts of prologue easier.
 - Fixed some minor bugs and grammatical errors.

The improved trailer has been released too! Watch it on the Steam page or watch it on YouTube.
